Codex review: needs changes before merge. ## What this changes This PR shares workspace inventories through content-addressed directory packs and persisted scan fingerprints in state schema 35. **Example:** Thirty projections repeatedly load overlapping workspace inventories. - **Before:** The reported v31 rotating-load median is 129.342 ms, with duplicated per-projection storage. - **After:** The reported directory-pack median is 68.482 ms, with shared immutable packs and unchanged manifest references. ## Review scores | Measure | Result | What it means | |---|---|---| | **Overall readiness** | 🦐 gold shrimp **(3/6)** | Useful, coherent implementation with substantial conversion coverage and no new actionable finding; performance acceptance remains incomplete. | | **Proof confidence** | 🦐 gold shrimp **(3/6)** | This maintainer-authored PR is outside the ordinary contributor proof gate; supplied real-data conversion and worker measurements are substantial, but the body explicitly marks the all-action performance acceptance gate incomplete. | | **Patch quality** | 🐚 platinum hermit **(4/6)** | No actionable review findings were identified. | ## Product **Kind:** Performance · **Worth it:** Yes · **Fix scope:** Complete **User problem:** Large managed workspaces duplicate inventories and occupy the shared writer during baseline replacement. **Reason:** The maintainer-selected direction has concrete storage and rotating-load gains, with the broader performance acceptance hold explicitly preserved. ## Merge readiness ⛔ **Needs changes before merge - 1 item remains** Keep open: this maintainer-authored PR provides useful storage improvements absent from main; no actionable introduced defect was found, but the author’s landing pause, reported conflicts, and failed CI gate remain. **Priority:** P2 **Reviewed head:** `01fb8948949423ca84352dd11fa0b86270efeb85` ## Before merge - [ ] **Complete next step** - Resolve GitHub’s reported merge conflicts and validate the affected integration changes. ## Findings None. ### Tests - Missing end-to-end proof: The declared clean all-action synthetic comparison remains incomplete for canonical, projection, and replacement actions across the read-only and publication boundaries.
Agent review details ### How this fits together Managed workspace reconciliation scans canonical and sandbox files, prepares immutable inventory content in workers, and publishes accepted roots and recovery receipts through the existing shared-state writer. ```mermaid flowchart TD A[Canonical and sandbox files] --> B[Manifest scan worker] B --> C[Directory packs and fingerprints] C --> D[Shared state writer] D --> E[Projection root and receipt] E --> F[Reconciliation and publication] E --> G[Workspace maintenance GC] ``` ### Technical review Best possible solution: Retain the directory-pack implementation and existing reconciliation owner, then satisfy the declared performance acceptance rule before landing. Do we have a high-confidence way to reproduce the issue? Current main stores complete per-worktree node inventories, and the supplied measurements establish duplicated storage and expensive replacement; no target code was executed during this review. Is this the best way to solve the issue? Directory-level sharing preserves existing digest and receipt contracts while removing the earlier cache design, but incomplete all-action measurements prevent confirming the full performance acceptance claim. AGENTS.md: found and applied where relevant. Codex review notes: model internal, reasoning medium; reviewed against [ce503a58dad3](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/ce503a58dad3b06cfba1cc357bab3e5a0435f024). ### Provenance checked - `Persistent manifests and checkpoint recovery` changes intended behavior with a stated reason (7ef85325b7c718f7ec27ecf496fe09a92a080d94: Persist incremental checkpoints while retaining atomic acceptance, pending receipts, and full-manifest publication.) - `Manifest snapshot decoding` keeps the original intent (6b3cf0c1f95ef1dd974ff029fb1c68af76af1a9e: Release encoded inventory rows before asynchronous filesystem discovery to reduce retained memory.) - `Worker-owned full-tree preparation` keeps the original intent (7462184039f5d1c22519b883aea97bfc97f1b7cd: Avoid Gateway stalls by building and preparing complete baseline trees in the existing read worker.) ### Testing Proof path: in-process harness. ### Security None. ### Evidence What I checked: - **Pinned change and current main:** The introduced comparison is 49aa6fca9a21fb21e31adb6c6e372451ba097b6a to the reviewed head; fetched main still declares shared-state schema 34 and reads per-worktree manifest nodes. ([`src/state/openclaw-schema-versions.ts:41`](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/ce503a58dad3b06cfba1cc357bab3e5a0435f024/src/state/openclaw-schema-versions.ts#L41), [ce503a58dad3](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/ce503a58dad3b06cfba1cc357bab3e5a0435f024)) - **Explicit landing pause:** The full PR body explicitly says STOP: the final all-action synthetic gate is invalid because host-load qualification prevented completion; the partial measurements do not authorize landing. ([01fb89489494](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/01fb8948949423ca84352dd11fa0b86270efeb85)) - **Migration evidence and accepted tradeoffs:** The body reports backed-up 33→34→35 conversion of 193 projections with exact equivalence, GC, and reload without missing packs; the maintainer discussion selects that migration scope and discloses older-writer refusal and backup-based rollback. ([`src/state/openclaw-state-db-schema-v35-workspace-cas.ts:17`](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/01fb8948949423ca84352dd11fa0b86270efeb85/src/state/openclaw-state-db-schema-v35-workspace-cas.ts#L17), [01fb89489494](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/01fb8948949423ca84352dd11fa0b86270efeb85)) - **Incremental preparation repaired:** The earlier review’s full-inventory preparation concern is addressed: incremental scans prepare packs selected from delta.records, with a production-owner regression covering acceptance, GC, and complete reload. ([`src/gateway/worker-environments/local-workspace-manifest-scan.ts:558`](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/01fb8948949423ca84352dd11fa0b86270efeb85/src/gateway/worker-environments/local-workspace-manifest-scan.ts#L558), [01fb89489494](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/01fb8948949423ca84352dd11fa0b86270efeb85)) - **Final commit authority retained:** Projection publication retains transaction-local reconciliation lease and registry-predicate checks; immutable preparation does not itself publish a projection root or authorize filesystem effects. ([`src/gateway/worker-environments/local-workspace-store.worker.ts:77`](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/01fb8948949423ca84352dd11fa0b86270efeb85/src/gateway/worker-environments/local-workspace-store.worker.ts#L77), [01fb89489494](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/01fb8948949423ca84352dd11fa0b86270efeb85)) - **Conflict and CI state:** GitHub reports mergeable=false and mergeable_state=dirty for the reviewed head; the linked CI run confirms three failed extension bundles and the aggregate gate, while the body attributes those failures to inherited behavior. ([01fb89489494](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/01fb8948949423ca84352dd11fa0b86270efeb85)) ### PR surface PR surface statistics unavailable: the file list is incomplete. ### Review metrics | Metric | Value | Why it matters | |---|---|---| | **Persistent format** | State 34→35; two tables and four nullable BLOB columns; agent schema remains 37 | The change requires forward migration and backup-based rollback, with online conversion owned by reconciliation. | | **Benchmark controls** | Two benchmark-only environment controls | OPENCLAW_BENCH_COMMIT and OPENCLAW_BENCH_COUNT_SQL select publication and instrumentation boundaries without adding product configuration. | ### Labels Label changes: - add `merge-risk: 🚨 compatibility`: Schema 35 deliberately refuses older writers and requires a verified backup plus matching build for rollback; the maintainer-authored change explicitly accepts this contract. - add `status: ⏳ waiting on author`: ClawSweeper has contributor-facing work open and is waiting for author action. Label justifications: - `P2`: Large-workspace storage and writer contention are meaningful improvements with a bounded affected surface. - `merge-risk: 🚨 compatibility`: Schema 35 deliberately refuses older writers and requires a verified backup plus matching build for rollback; the maintainer-authored change explicitly accepts this contract. - `rating: 🦐 gold shrimp`: Overall readiness is 🦐 gold shrimp; proof is 🦐 gold shrimp and patch quality is 🐚 platinum hermit. - `status: ⏳ waiting on author`: ClawSweeper has contributor-facing work open and is waiting for author action. ### Rank-up moves Optional improvements that raise the rating; they are not merge blockers. - Complete the declared all-action performance comparison under its qualifying host conditions. ### Rating scale 6/6 🦀 challenger crab · 5/6 🦞 diamond lobster · 4/6 🐚 platinum hermit · 3/6 🦐 gold shrimp · 2/6 🦪 silver shellfish · 1/6 🧂 unranked krab. Overall follows the weaker of proof and patch quality; ✨ marks media proof (a screenshot, video, or linked artifact) that directly shows the changed behavior. ### Workflow ClawSweeper edits this one comment on every review. Comment `@clawsweeper re-review` for a fresh review only. Repair and merge execution lanes are retired. ### History
Review history (2 earlier review cycles) - reviewed 2026-10-26T12:09:15.814Z sha bd4a655fd1fe1ed98b86fcbf4432ce41c62c801d :: blocked before merge. :: none - reviewed 2026-10-26T17:35:54.612Z sha a13c55b19c6220be34a089b9ed610935d97b29b8 :: needs maintainer review before merge. :: none
